project_type: Single-process Python application: modular pipeline (Discover -> Normalize -> Deduplicate -> Verify -> Rank -> Display) backed by SQLite behind a repository, fronted by a server-rendered web UI. Single-user, offline-first, fixture-driven. NOT microservices.
language: Python 3.11+ (uses StrEnum, PEP 604 unions, from __future__ import annotations).
build_system: uv-managed venv; hatchling build backend. Dev deps (ruff, black, mypy, pytest) under [project.optional-dependencies].dev in pyproject.toml. Add new runtime deps with `uv add <pkg>` (updates pyproject + uv.lock).
test_framework: pytest (>=8). Tests live under tests/ mirroring package modules (test_config.py, test_models.py, test_fixtures.py, test_smoke.py exist). testpaths=['tests'], addopts='-ra -q'.
build_command: make install  (uv sync --python 3.11 --extra dev). No compile step for Python.
test_command: make test  (uv run pytest). Full gate: make check = lint + format-check + typecheck + test.
verification_instructions: For each feature run `make check` from /projects/sandbox (runs `uv run ruff check .`, `uv run black --check .`, `uv run mypy` in strict mode, `uv run pytest`). All four MUST pass. Run targeted tests during development with `uv run pytest tests/test_<module>.py`. Baseline is green today; never regress it. Every new module must pass ruff, black, and mypy --strict and be covered by pytest.
snapshot_or_generated_files: SQLite DB file produced by the seed/run pipeline (e.g. store.db) is a runtime artifact, NOT checked in (add to .gitignore if needed). uv.lock is checked in and updated by `uv add`. No other generated-checked-in files.
environment_constraints: OFFLINE ONLY: no live network, no real API keys. config.offline defaults True. All source data comes from tests/fixtures/*.json (+ one .html). Wire a FixtureFetcher/fixture source adapters so the app runs with no network out of the box. mypy is strict: annotate everything, no untyped defs, no implicit Optional. ruff line-length 88, rules E,F,I,UP,B,W. black line-length 88. Every module starts with `from __future__ import annotations`.
contribution_requirements: No AGENTS.md/CONTRIBUTING.md/steering files exist. Conventions come from existing code: module docstring referencing the design/req section + task id (e.g. 'design.md §2.1, T0.4'); dataclasses for data; StrEnum for discrete states; pure/no-I/O for normalize/dedup/ranking; interfaces via typing.Protocol; constructor injection for sources/providers/fetcher/repository so offline/fixture wiring is swappable. Reuse M0 config/models/fixtures verbatim; do not rewrite them.
key_patterns: config.py already holds ALL tunables: RankingConfig.weights (food_confirmed 0.25, full_meal 0.25, food_specificity 0.15, rsvp_likelihood 0.10, timing 0.05, walking 0.10, confidence 0.10), walking_unknown_value 0.5, timing_good_start_hour 11 / end 20; DedupConfig.merge_threshold 0.75 / review_low 0.55 / time_proximity_minutes 30; authority_precedence [official_page, anchor_link, google_calendar]; reference_location Kirkland Hall 36.1487,-86.8027; providers.location default haversine. models.py already defines Event, SourceRecord, FieldProvenance, Conflict/CompetingValue, ScoreComponent, EventHistory, GeoPoint and enums VerificationState, FoodConfirmed, FoodCategory, SourceId, ParseStatus, FieldAgreement, ScoreFactor. fixtures.py loads the corpus offline (load_all_json_fixtures, load_json_fixture, load_text_fixture, list_json_fixtures, list_html_fixtures). Fixture records carry both raw_payload and a precomputed parsed_fields dict with keys: title, event_date (YYYY-MM-DD), start_time/end_time (HH:MM), location, organizer, rsvp_required, rsvp_url, event_url, food_confirmed, food_category, food_description, optional cancelled(bool). Top-level keys: source_id, source_url, checked_at (ISO8601 w/ offset), source_updated_at, parse_status, raw_payload, raw_payload_file (HTML), parse_error. Web framework decision: Flask + Jinja2 (server-rendered, minimal footprint). Fixture event dates are 2025-03-11 so the seed step must retarget dates onto 'tomorrow' or the web page will be empty.
relevant_files: vandy_food_radar/config.py (REUSE: weights, thresholds, precedence, ref location, providers, timezone, target window, offline)
tests/fixtures/pizza_night_anchor_link.json + pizza_night_google_calendar.json (must MERGE to one event; slightly different titles)
tests/fixtures/conflicting_time_*.json (anchor 18:00, gcal 18:30, official 18:00 top authority -> resolve to 18:00, preserve 18:30 conflict)
tests/test_fixtures.py + test_config.py + test_models.py (patterns to follow for new tests)
.kiro/specs/vandy-food-radar/{requirements.md,design.md,tasks.md,assumptions.md} (source of truth: design §1.1 layering, §2 data model, §4 dedup, §5 verify, §6.1 weights)
Makefile (uv + make targets; add seed/run/demo), README.md (add launch docs), pyproject.toml (add flask via uv add)
directory_structure: vandy_food_radar/ holds the package (config.py, models.py, fixtures.py, __init__.py today). NEW subpackages to create, one per concern per design §1.1: store/ (repository + sqlite), sources/ (adapters + fetcher + factory), normalize/ (datetime, food classifier, normalizer), dedup/ (similarity, deduplicator), verify/ (conflict, verifier), providers/ (location, calendar), ranking/ (engine, explanation), pipeline/ (orchestrator), web/ (Flask app + templates/ + static/), plus cli.py / __main__.py. tests/ mirrors with test_store.py, test_sources.py, test_normalize.py, test_dedup.py, test_verify.py, test_ranking.py, test_web.py, test_pipeline_e2e.py. tests/fixtures/ holds the corpus (do not modify). The web layer reads ONLY through the Repository; providers/sources/fetcher are injected.
